pages.text: $(o)A loose leaf, written in a hand that trembles.$(br2)The Portal is not finished.$(br)It never was.$(br2)When the sky went out we did not go back to it.$(br)We left the work half done and sealed what little was left,$(br)the way you close a door you no longer know how to open.

pages.title: The Watchers' Vault
pages.text: Cut into living rock, where the Order kept what was not yet spent.

The stones are missing. Not the shape, which is already there, but the matter:$(br2)the Order's stone is neither cut nor bought.$(br)It was stored underground, in a warehouse cut into living rock,$(br)far from the surface and from any path a curious person could follow.$(br2)The Illumination Stone comes with this leaf. Set it on the Vault's altar:$(br)that is what wakes it.$(br2)$(o)Look for it. Go down.$(br)And do not go alone: nobody goes down there alone.$()
